story.heading: A Friendship. A Heritage. A Passion for Spain's Finest.
story.p1: Jorge Soto and Roberto Segovia Perez met in Marseille, France while Jorge was on his honeymoon with his wife. What began as a chance meeting quickly became a lifelong friendship built on a shared love for food, culture, and connection.
story.p2: Years later, while Roberto was visiting Miami, they dreamed of bringing the authentic flavors of Spain to the world. Inspired by Jorge's Spanish heritage and generations of family tradition, Soto & Segovia Imports was born.
story.p3: Today, we continue that legacy — curating the finest artisan products from Spain and sharing them with those who value quality, authenticity, and excellence.
